skill.name: learn
skill.description: Captures project-specific insights from the current conversation and stores them in a knowledge base for later sessions.
skill.summary: Records patterns, quirks, and decisions from a conversation into project knowledge files.

content.value_statement: Project insights often disappear after a session ends. This skill extracts patterns, quirks, and decisions and records them in a persistent knowledge base.
actual_capabilities: Reviews the current conversation for reusable project insights.
Classifies findings as patterns, quirks, or decisions.
Appends entries to knowledge/learnings Markdown files.
Updates entry counts and last-updated metadata in learning files.
Summarizes what was learned for the user.
limitations: Uses only the current conversation as its source.
Requires write access to the project knowledge files.
Does not verify insights against external sources.
Users should review entries before storing sensitive information.

use_cases.title: Document Reusable Fixes
use_cases.description: Save a debugging approach that worked, so future sessions can apply it quickly.

use_cases.title: Track Project Quirks
use_cases.description: Record non-standard behavior and workarounds discovered during implementation or review.

use_cases.title: Preserve Design Decisions
use_cases.description: Capture the choice, context, and rationale behind a project decision.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Simple Learning
prompt_templates.prompt: Use learn to record the most important project-specific insight from this conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Record Debugging Knowledge
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this conversation and save any verified patterns, quirks, or decisions in the project knowledge base.

prompt_templates.title: Curate Multiple Insights
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract only high-confidence and medium-confidence insights, skip duplicates, and update the learning metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Handoff Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Learn from this session and report which entries were added, skipped, or treated as tentative.
prompt_templates.scenario: Before handing work to another developer.

output_examples.input: The team found that generated clients must be rebuilt after schema changes.
output_examples.output: Added one pattern about rebuilding generated clients after schema updates. The knowledge base count increased by one.

output_examples.input: A review found auth tokens need custom decoding in this repository.
output_examples.output: Added one quirk about custom token decoding and noted the workaround for future sessions.

output_examples.input: The project chose server-side validation instead of client-only checks.
output_examples.output: Added one decision with the context, selected approach, and rationale.

best_practices: Run the skill after important discoveries, not after every small reply.
Keep entries specific to this project and include evidence from the conversation.
Review proposed entries for secrets, personal data, and duplicate knowledge.
anti_patterns: Do not store generic programming advice that does not depend on this project.
Do not record low-confidence guesses as confirmed knowledge.
Do not include credentials, private customer data, or unrelated conversation details.

faq.question: What does this skill store?
faq.answer: It stores project-specific patterns, quirks, and decisions from the current conversation.

faq.question: Where are learnings written?
faq.answer: It writes to learning files under the project knowledge base and updates extraction state metadata.

faq.question: Does it run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill is user-invokable and is intended to run when the user asks for learning extraction.

faq.question: Can it remember information across sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. It records selected insights in persistent project files that later sessions can read.

faq.question: How should sensitive information be handled?
faq.answer: Review entries before saving and remove secrets, personal data, and private customer details.

faq.question: Does it replace project documentation?
faq.answer: No. It captures operational learning that can support, not replace, formal documentation.
